rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clause may coordinate with an implied cause such as taking vengeance, or with the conditional consequence.
rows.anchor: عطف على علة مقدرة مثل لينتقم منهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The accusative is the answer to six conditional elements, since this outcome too is not obligatory.
rows.anchor: ونصب نصب الواقع جوابا للأشياء الستة لأنه أيضا غير واجب

rows.speaker: نافع وابن عامر
rows.claim: Nafi and Ibn Amir read the verb in the nominative as a new sentence.
rows.anchor: وقرأ نافع وابن عامر بالرفع على الاسئتناف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An unnamed reading has the jussive, coordinated with يعف; this combines destruction, rescue, and warning of different groups.
rows.anchor: فيكون المعنى ويجمع بين إهلاك قوم وإنجاء قوم وتحذير آخرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: محيص means a place or means of escape from punishment.
rows.anchor: محيد من العذاب والجملة معلق عنها الفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clause ما لهم من محيص suspends the verb from taking an object.
rows.anchor: ما لهم من محيص } محيد من العذاب والجملة معلق عنها الفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whatever people receive is enjoyment during worldly life; what is with God is the afterlife's reward.
rows.anchor: فمتع الحيوة الدنيا } تمتعون به مدة حياتكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The afterlife's reward is better and more enduring for believers who rely on God because its benefit is pure and lasting.
rows.anchor: لخلوص نفعه ودوامه و { ما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first ما is relative but conditional in force: receiving causes worldly enjoyment, hence the answer takes فاء; the second ما differs.
rows.anchor: الأولى موصولة تضمنت معنى الشرط من حيث أن إيتاء ما أوتوا

rows.speaker: علي
rows.claim: Ali reports that Abu Bakr gave all his wealth in charity, a group reproached him, and this verse was revealed.
rows.anchor: وعن علي رضي الله تعالى عنه: تصدق أبو بكر رضي الله تعالى عنه بماله كله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earlier prophets' being mocked consoles the Messenger over his people's mockery.
rows.anchor: تسلية لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن استهزاء قومه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Them” means the profligate people; the discourse shifts from addressing them to reporting about them to the Messenger.
rows.anchor: أي من القوم المسرفين لأنه صرف الخطاب عنهم إلى الرسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earlier peoples' remarkable stories already passed in the Quran, promising the Messenger and warning his opponents of a similar fate.
rows.anchor: وسلف في القرآن قصتهم العجيبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The attributes may be implicit in what they say, supplying its content: as elsewhere, they effectively say “God.”
rows.anchor: لعله لازم مقولهم أو ما دل عليه إجمالا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, “the Mighty, Knowing” is their actual answer and the following description begins a new sentence.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون مقولهم وما بعده استئناف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made the earth a resting place where people settle.
rows.anchor: جعل لكم الأرض مهدا } فتستقرون فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Readers outside Kufa read مهادا with a long alif.
rows.anchor: وقرىء غير الكوفيين «مهادا» بالإلف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The paths through the earth are routes for people to travel.
rows.anchor: وجعل لكم فيها سبلا } تسلكونها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People may reach their destinations by them, or recognize the Creator's wisdom through reflection.
rows.anchor: لكي تهتدوا إلى مقاصدكم، أو إلى حكمة الصانع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rain is sent in an amount that benefits and does no harm.
rows.anchor: ماء بقدر } بمقدار ينفع ولا يضر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: بلدة takes a masculine adjective because it can mean البلد or المكان, both masculine.
rows.anchor: وتذكيره لأن البلدة بمعنى البلد والمكان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As the dead land is revived, people will be raised from their graves.
rows.anchor: كذلك } مثل ذلك الإنشار. { تخرجون } تنشرون من قبوركم

rows.speaker: ابن عامر وحمزة والكسائي
rows.claim: Ibn Amir, Hamza, and al-Kisa'i read تخرجون with open تاء and damma on راء.
rows.anchor: وقرأ ابن عامر وحمزة والكسائي { تخرجون } بفتح التاء وضم الراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الأزواج means all kinds of created things.
rows.anchor: ما تركبونه على تغليب المتعدي بنفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording generalizes what is ridden by favoring the directly transitive verb; it may also favor animals made for riding over ships made for it, or common over rare usage.
rows.anchor: على تغليب المتعدي بنفسه على المتعدي بغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plural “backs” follows the meaning of the things people ride.
rows.anchor: أي ظهور ما تركبون وجمعه للمعنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Riders should remember the blessing inwardly, acknowledging and praising God.
rows.anchor: تذكروها بقلوبكم معترفين بها حامدين عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مقرنين means able to master it; the root suggests finding its counterpart, since a difficult thing cannot be a weak person's peer.
rows.anchor: مطيقين من أقرن الشيء إذا أطاقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A doubled reading is also reported, with the same meaning.
rows.anchor: الضعيف. وقرىء بالتشديد والمعنى واحد

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet said “In God's name” when placing his foot in the stirrup, then praised God once settled on the riding animal.
rows.anchor: وعنه عليه الصلاة والسلام أنه كان إذا وضع رجله في الركاب قال:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: منقلبون means that the riders will return to God.
rows.anchor: وإنا إلى ربنا لمنقلبون } أي راجعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The return completes the travel imagery: riding entails movement, whose greatest journey is the return to God; alternatively, travel reminds riders of death and to prepare for meeting God.
rows.anchor: واتصاله بذلك لأن الركوب للتنقل والنقلة العظمى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They have no rational or transmitted proof, but follow ignorant ancestors; أمة means a path one aims toward, like a mount for a destination.
rows.anchor: أي لا حجة لهم على عقلية ولا نقلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading with kasra makes أمة a person's condition; it can also mean religion.
rows.anchor: وقرئت بالكسر وهي الحالة التي يكون عليها الأم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The recurring pattern consoles the Messenger and shows blind imitation to be an old error; earlier leaders also lacked considered evidence.
rows.anchor: تسلية لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ودلالة على أن التقليد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mentioning the affluent signals that luxury and idleness distracted them from reflection and led to imitation.
rows.anchor: وتخصيص المترفين إشعار بأن التنعم وحب البطالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question asks whether they would follow their fathers even if the warner brought a more guiding religion; it may recount a past command or address the Messenger.
rows.anchor: أي أتتبعون آبائكم ولو جئتكم بدين أهدى

rows.speaker: ابن عامر وحفص
rows.claim: Ibn Amir and Hafs read قال (“he said”), supporting the interpretation that this recounts a past command to an earlier warner.
rows.anchor: ويؤيد الأول أنه قرأ ابن عامر وحفص { قال }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their refusal even if the new religion is more guiding makes the warner give up hope that they will consider it.
rows.anchor: إقناطا للنذير من أن ينظروا أو يتفكروا فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The punishment is not eased; the root conveys weakness, as when a fever subsides.
rows.anchor: لا يخفف عنهم من فترت عنه الحمى إذا سكنت قليلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They despair of escape while in the punishment.
rows.anchor: في العذاب { مبلسون } آيسون من النجاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: هم is a separating pronoun, emphasizing that they themselves were the wrongdoers.
rows.anchor: مر مثله غير مرة وهم فصل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading addresses him as يا مال, shortened by truncation and with either kasra or damma.
rows.anchor: وقرىء «يا مال» على الترخيم مكسورا ومضموما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their shortened address may signal weakness; asking God to end them is a cry and wish for death from torment, not inconsistent with despair.
rows.anchor: ولعله إشعار بأنهم لضعفهم لا يستطيعون تأدية اللفظ بالتمام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask their Lord to cause them to die; this is a cry and wish for death from extreme severity.
rows.anchor: والمعنى سل ربنا أن يقضي علينا من قضى عليه إذا أماته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They have no escape through death or any other means.
rows.anchor: لا خلاص لكم بموت ولا بغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Coming with the truth means sending the Messenger and revealing scripture.
rows.anchor: لقد جئنكم بالحق } بالإرسال والإنزال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If قال has God as its subject, this continues His answer; otherwise it is God's reply after Malik's answer.
rows.anchor: إن كان في { قال } ضمير الله وإلا فجواب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most hate truth because following it burdens the soul and requires proper conduct of the limbs.
rows.anchor: لما في اتباعه من إتعاب النفس وآداب الجوارح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They may have resolved to reject truth, while God resolves to requite them; alternatively, they plotted against the Messenger and God plots against them, a worse offense than mere hatred.
rows.anchor: أو أم أحكم المشركون أمرا من كيدهم بالرسول { فإنا مبرمون } كيدنا بهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sundus is fine silk and istabraq thick silk; the latter is borrowed from Persian or derived from brightness.
rows.anchor: والسندس ما رق من الحرير والاستبرق ما غلظ منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase may be a second predicate, a circumstantial clause, or a new sentence.
rows.anchor: خبر ثان أو حال من الضمير في الجار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They face one another in their gatherings so they can enjoy one another's company.
rows.anchor: في مجالسهم ليستأنس بعضهم ببعض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: كذلك can mean that this is how the matter is, or that God gave them the like of that.
rows.anchor: الأمر كذلك أو آتيناهم مثل ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verb takes باء because it means pairing them with the houris.
rows.anchor: قرناهم بهن ولذلك عدي بالباء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A حوراء is white and an عيناء has large eyes; it is disputed whether they are worldly women or others.
rows.anchor: والحوراء البيضاء والعيناء عظيمة العينين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They request whatever fruit they desire, without restriction by place or season, and are safe from harm.
rows.anchor: يطلبون ويأمرون بإحضار ما يشتهون من الفواكه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They live there forever; the exception may be disconnected or connected, with death as the first state of the afterlife, or the Garden as what believers approach and see at death.
rows.anchor: والاستثناء منقطع أو متصل والضمير للآخرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the exception hyperbolically generalizes the negation: tasting the first death in the future is impossible.
rows.anchor: أو الاستثناء للمبالغة في تعميم النفي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading with doubled قاف intensifies “and He protected them.”
rows.anchor: عذاب الجحيم } وقرىء «ووقهم» على المبالغة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All this was granted as bounty from the Lord; another reading has the nominative, “that is a favor.”
rows.anchor: أي أعطوا كل ذلك عطاء وتفضلا منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading puts فضلا in the nominative, meaning “that is a favor.”
rows.anchor: وقرىء بالرفع أي ذلك فضل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is the great triumph because it removes harms and obtains what is desired.
rows.anchor: لأنه خلاص عن المكاره وفوز بالمطالب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made the Quran easy by revealing it in the Messenger's language; this summarizes the sura.
rows.anchor: سهلناه حيث أنزلناه بلغتك وهو فذلكة السورة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They may understand it and recall through it what they had not previously recalled.
rows.anchor: لعلهم يفهمونه فيتذكرون به ما لم يتذكروا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Messenger should await what will befall his opponents, as they await what will befall him.
rows.anchor: فارتقب } فانتظر ما يحل بهم

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet says whoever recites Ha Mim al-Dukhan on Friday night awakens forgiven; no grading is stated.
rows.anchor: من قرأ حم الدخان ليلة جمعة أصبح مغفورا له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sura is Meccan and its verse count is given as thirty-four or thirty-five.
rows.anchor: مكية وآيها أربع أو خمس وثلاثون آية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creation is joined to truth, meaning what wisdom and justice require; this proves a wise Creator and resurrection for recompense.
rows.anchor: إلا خلقا ملتبسا بالحق وهو ما تقتضيه الحكمة والمعدلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creation in truth indicates a wise Creator and resurrection for recompense.
rows.anchor: والبعث للمجازاة على ما قررناه مرارا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The appointed term may be the end of all things at Resurrection, or each individual's allotted lifespan.
rows.anchor: ينتهي إليه الكل وهو يوم القيامة، أو كل واحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers turn from the terror of that time and do not reflect or prepare; ما may be a verbal noun.
rows.anchor: من هول ذلك الوقت، ويجوز أن تكون «ما» مصدرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The challenge asks whether their gods contributed to creating any part of the world such that they merit worship.
rows.anchor: هل يعقل أن يكون لها في أنفسها مدخل في خلق شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mentioning partnership in the heavens guards against imagining that intermediaries share in producing earthly events.
rows.anchor: أي أخبروني عن حال آلهتكم بعد تأمل فيها، هل يعقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They must produce a scripture predating the Quran that affirms God's oneness.
rows.anchor: من قبل هذا الكتاب يعني القرآن فإنه ناطق بالتوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, they must produce ancient learning supporting their gods' right to worship or a command to worship them.
rows.anchor: أو بقية من علم بقيت عليكم من علوم الأولين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The challenge first denies rational grounds for their gods and then denies transmitted proof.
rows.anchor: نقلا بعد إلزامهم بعدم ما يقتضيها عقلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إثارة with kasra can mean debate that stirs meanings; أثرة may mean something selected or passed down, with three hamza vowels explained by derivation and usage.
rows.anchor: أي مناظرة فإن المناظرة تثير المعاني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The implied question is whether they return after dying and becoming dust, as the following phrase shows.
rows.anchor: أي أنرجع إذا متنا وصرنا ترابا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The return seems remote from imagination, customary experience, or possibility; الرجع may instead mean the returned thing.
rows.anchor: بعيد عن الوهم أو العادة أو الإمكان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth consumes dead bodies; this answers their objection by removing the underlying difficulty.
rows.anchor: ما تأكل من أجساد موتاهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, this is the oath's answer, with لام omitted because the intervening speech is long.
rows.anchor: وقيل إنه جواب القسم واللام محذوف لطول الكلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The book preserves all details or is preserved from alteration; it represents God's knowledge or confirms it through the Preserved Tablet.
rows.anchor: حافظ لتفاصيل الأشياء كلها، أو محفوظ عن التغيير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “The truth” may mean prophethood confirmed by miracles, the Prophet, or the Quran.
rows.anchor: يعني النبوة الثابتة بالمعجزات، أو النبي صلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading has لما with kasra on its initial لام.
rows.anchor: لما جاءهم فهم } وقرىء «لما» بالكسر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مريج means confused or unstable, like a ring slipping from a finger; they call the Messenger a poet, magician, and soothsayer.
rows.anchor: مضطرب من مرج الخاتم في أصبعه إذا خرج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: رزقا is either the purpose of growing plants or a verbal noun, since growth itself is provision.
rows.anchor: علة ل { أنبتنا } أو مصدر، فإن الإنبات رزق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The land revived by water is barren and has no growth.
rows.anchor: أرضا جدبة لا نماء فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As the land comes alive, people emerge alive after death.
rows.anchor: كما حييت هذه البلدة يكون خروجكم أحياء بعد موتكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Pharaoh” denotes him and his people, to fit the surrounding list.
rows.anchor: أراد بفرعون إياه وقومه ليلائم ما قبله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot's “brothers” means his companions, who were his relatives by marriage.
rows.anchor: وإخون لوط } أخدانه لأنهم كانوا أصهاره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sura is Meccan and has sixty verses.
rows.anchor: مكية وآيها ستون آية بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The scatterers may be winds, fertile women, or causes such as angels that disperse creatures.
rows.anchor: ذروا } يعني الرياح تذرو التراب وغيره، أو النساء الولود

rows.speaker: أبو عمرو وحمزة
rows.claim: Abu Amr and Hamza assimilate the تاء into the ذال.
rows.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو وحمزة بإدغام التاء في الذال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The burden-bearers may be rain-bearing clouds, winds carrying clouds, pregnant women, or their causes.
rows.anchor: فالسحب الحاملة للأمطار، أو الرياح الحاملة للسحاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading takes وقرا as naming the thing carried with the verbal noun.
rows.anchor: وقرىء «وقرا» على تسمية المحمول بالمصدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The things running easily may be ships, winds in their courses, or stars in their stations.
rows.anchor: فالسفن الجارية في البحر سهلا، أو الرياح الجارية في مهابها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: يسرا describes an omitted verbal noun: an easy running.
rows.anchor: صفة مصدر محذوف أي جريا ذا يسر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dividers may be angels distributing rain and provisions, all distributing causes, or winds distributing rain by directing clouds.
rows.anchor: الملائكة التي تقسم الأمور من الأمطار والأرزاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the oath terms are different beings, ف orders them by increasing evidence of power; if one kind, it orders the actions by which winds form, carry, move, and distribute clouds.
rows.anchor: فإن حملت على ذوات مختلفة بالفاء لترتيب الأقسام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not abandon admonition: it benefits those destined to believe or believers by increasing their insight.
rows.anchor: ولا تدع التذكير والموعظة. { فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humans and jinn were created with a disposition toward worship, making it their aim emphatically; a literal reading is barred by 7:179.
rows.anchor: لما خلقهم على صورة متوجهة إلى العبادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The literal sense is precluded by the statement that many jinn and humans were created for Hell.
rows.anchor: ولقد ذرأنا لجهنم كثيرا من الجن والإنس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view is that God created them to command them to worship or to be His servants.
rows.anchor: وقيل معناه إلا لأمرهم بالعبادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not occupy people with earning His provision; they should attend to what they were created and commanded to do.
rows.anchor: ما أريد أن أصرفكم في تحصيل رزقي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unlike human masters who use servants to support their livelihood, God does not need help from His servants.
rows.anchor: ليس شأن السادة مع عبيدهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An implied قل would make this equivalent to 6:90, “I ask you no wage for it.”
rows.anchor: ويحتمل أن يقدر بقل فيكون بمعنى قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God provides every being that needs provision, signaling His independence from it.
rows.anchor: الذي يرزق كل ما يفتقر إلى الرزق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading has إني أنا الرزاق.
rows.anchor: باستغنائه عنه، وقرىء «إني أنا الرزاق»

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading puts المتين in the genitive as an adjective of القوة; it means strong in power.
rows.anchor: شديد القوة، وقرىء { المتين } بالجر صفة ل { القوة }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Major sins are those with grave punishment, specifically sins with a stated threat.
rows.anchor: ما يكبر عقابه من الذنوب وهو ما رتب عليه الوعيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another definition of major sins is those that incur a fixed penalty.
rows.anchor: الوعيد بخصوصه. وقيل ما أوجب الحد

rows.speaker: حمزة والكسائي وخلف
rows.claim: Hamza, al-Kisa'i, and Khalaf read كبير الإثم, intending the genus or idolatry.
rows.anchor: وقرأ حمزة والكسائي وخلف كبير الإثم على إرادة الجنس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الفواحش means especially what is obscene among major sins.
rows.anchor: ما فحش من الكبائر خصوصا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception means small sins, forgiven for those who avoid major sins; it is a disconnected exception.
rows.anchor: إلا ما قل وصغر فإنه مغفور من مجتنبي الكبائر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الذين may be accusative as an adjective or praise, or nominative as predicate of an omitted subject.
rows.anchor: ومحل { الذين } النصب على الصفة أو المدح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God may forgive minor sins when major ones are avoided, or any sins He wills; this prevents despair and the claim that punishment is incumbent on God.
rows.anchor: حيث يغفر الصغائر باجتناب الكبائر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows people's states better than they do, from their creation from earth and formation in the womb.
rows.anchor: هو أعلم بكم } أعلم بأحوالكم منكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not praise yourselves for righteous deeds or claim purity from sins and base traits.
rows.anchor: فلا تثنوا عليها بزكاء العمل وزيادة الخير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knew the pious and others before bringing them forth from Adam's loins.
rows.anchor: قبل أن يخرجكم من صلب آدم عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ship ran within God's sight, meaning it was protected by Him.
rows.anchor: بمرأى منا أي محفوظة بحفظنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God did this as reward for Noah, a blessing his people disbelieved; every prophet is a blessing and mercy to his community.
rows.anchor: أي فعلنا ذلك جزاء لنوح لأنه نعمة كفروها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The construction may omit a preposition and make the verb transitive to the pronoun.
rows.anchor: على حذف الجار وإيصال الفعل إلى الضمير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading has لمن كفر, “for the disbelievers.”
rows.anchor: وقرىء «لمن كفر» أي للكافرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The thing left as a sign may be the ship or the deed/event.
rows.anchor: تركنها } أي السفينة أو الفعلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It serves as a lesson because its story spread widely.
rows.anchor: يعتبر بها إذ شاع خبرها واشتهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مدكر means one who takes heed; readings preserve the original form or assimilate تاء into ذال.
rows.anchor: وقرىء «مذتكر» على الأصل، و «مذكر» بقلب التاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question magnifies punishment and warns; نذر may be an infinitive or plural.
rows.anchor: استفهام تعظيم ووعيد، والنذر يحتمل المصدر والجمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made the Quran easy or prepared it, as one prepares a camel for travel.
rows.anchor: سهلناه أو هيأناه من يسر ناقته للسفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is easy for admonition through varied lessons, or for memorization through concise and pleasant wording.
rows.anchor: للادكار والاتعاظ بأن صرفنا فيه أنواع المواعظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hour is their time for primary punishment; worldly punishment is only a precursor.
rows.anchor: موعد عذابهم الأصلي وما يحيق بهم في الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أدهى means more severe; a داهية is dreadful and without a known remedy; the punishment is more bitter to taste.
rows.anchor: أدهى } أشد، والداهية أمر فظيع لا يهتدي لدوائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The criminals are astray from truth in this world and in blazing fires in the next.
rows.anchor: عن الحق في الدنيا. { وسعر } ونيران في الآخرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are dragged face down through the fire.
rows.anchor: يوم يسحبون في النار على وجوههم } يجرون عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are told to taste the fire's heat and pain, since touching it causes suffering; Saqar is an indeclinable name for Hell, from scorching.
rows.anchor: أي يقال لهم ذوقوا حر النار وألمها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Everything is created to a measure and order suited to wisdom, or measured and written in the Preserved Tablet before it occurs.
rows.anchor: مقدرا مرتبا على مقتضى الحكمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the accusative reading, كل شيء is object of a verb explained by what follows; in the nominative it is the subject and خلقناه its predicate.
rows.anchor: وكل شيء منصوب بفعل يفسره ما بعده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Blessings include ship materials, guidance on taking and assembling them, and navigation at sea through causes only God can create and combine.
rows.anchor: من خلق مواد السفن والإرشاد إلى أخذها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: من may include animals or material beings on earth by grammatical predominance, or both humans and jinn.
rows.anchor: من على الأرض من الحيوانات أو المركبات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The enduring “face” is God's essence: created things are finite in themselves, except God's face, the aspect facing His direction.
rows.anchor: ذاته ولو استقريت جهات الموجودات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ذو الجلال والإكرام means absolute self-sufficiency and general bounty.
rows.anchor: ذو الاستغناء المطلق والفضل العام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessings include God's abiding and preserving what nears perishing, or resurrection, everlasting life, and bliss that follow universal perishing.
rows.anchor: من بقاء الرب وإبقاء ما لا يحصى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All in heaven and earth need God in their being, attributes, and concerns; asking signals need, whether spoken or otherwise.
rows.anchor: فإنهم مفتقرون إليه في ذواتهم وصفاتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At every time God brings persons into being and determines their states according to prior decree.
rows.anchor: كل وقت يحدث أشخاصا ويحدد أحوالا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A hadith says God's activity includes forgiving sin, relieving distress, raising some people, and lowering others.
rows.anchor: من شأنه أن يغفر ذنبا ويفرج كربا ويرفع قوما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This refutes the Jewish claim that God decrees nothing on the Sabbath.
rows.anchor: وهو رد لقول اليهود إن الله لا يقضي يوم السبت شيئا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: فيهن may mean within the gardens, their places and palaces, or the enumerated blessings of gardens, springs, fruit, and couches.
rows.anchor: في الجنان فإن جنتان تدل على جنان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are women who restrict their gaze to their husbands.
rows.anchor: نساء قصرن أبصارهن على أزواجهن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Neither human nor jinn has touched them; this indicates that jinn have sexual intercourse.
rows.anchor: لم يمس الإنسيات إنس ولا الجنيات جن

rows.speaker: الكسائي
rows.claim: Al-Kisa'i reads the ميم with a damma.
rows.anchor: أن الجن يطمثون. وقرأ الكسائي بضم الميم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their ruby-and-coral likeness describes red cheeks, white skin, and its clarity.
rows.anchor: أي حمرة الوجنة وبياض البشرة وصفائهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first إحسان is excellence in deeds and the second excellence in reward, namely the Garden.
rows.anchor: في العمل. { إلا الإحسن } في الثواب وهو الجنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two gardens below the first pair are for people of lower rank among the companions of the right hand.
rows.anchor: لمن دونهم من أصحاب اليمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gardens are green tending to black from intense greenery; ground-covering plants dominate, unlike the first pair's trees and fruit, showing relative rank.
rows.anchor: خضراوان تضربان إلى السواد من شدة الخضرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The springs gush with water, but less abundantly than the first pair's; the same applies to what follows.
rows.anchor: فوارتان بالماء هو أيضا أقل مما وصف به الأوليين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Palm fruit and pomegranates are singled out to show distinction: dates are food and fruit; pomegranates fruit and medicine.
rows.anchor: فإن ثمرة النخل فاكهة وغذاء وثمرة الرمان فاكهة ودواء

rows.speaker: أبو حنيفة
rows.claim: Abu Hanifa argues that one who swears not to eat fruit does not break the oath by eating fresh dates or pomegranates.
rows.anchor: واحتج به أبو حنيفة رضي الله تعالى عنه على أن من حلف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: خيرات is shortened because خير in the sense of أخير is not pluralized; another reading preserves the original form.
rows.anchor: أي خيرات فخففت لأن خيرا الذي بمعنى أخير لا يجمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The women are beautiful in both character and appearance.
rows.anchor: وقد قرىء على الأصل. { حسان } حسان الخلق والخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The water people drink is fresh and fit for drinking.
rows.anchor: الماء الذى تشربون } أي العذب الصالح للشرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: المزن means clouds, singular مزنة; another view takes it as white cloud, whose water is purer.
rows.anchor: واحده مزنة، وقيل { المزن } السحاب الأبيض وماؤه أعذب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If رؤية means knowing, the clause is governed by the interrogative.
rows.anchor: والرؤية إن كانت بمعنى العلم فمتعلقة بالاستفهام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God could make the water salty, or burning in the mouth from أجيج.
rows.anchor: ملحا أو من الأجيج فإنه يحرق الفم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The separating لام is omitted before the conditional answer because its position is understood, because it appeared earlier, or to emphasize the more important clause.
rows.anchor: وحذف اللام الفاصلة بين جواب ما يتمحض للشرط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People should be grateful for necessities such as water.
rows.anchor: فلولا تشكرون } أمثال هذه النعم الضرورية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: تورون means striking fire and producing sparks.
rows.anchor: النار التى تورون } تقدحون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tree is the one from which fire-starting sticks are made.
rows.anchor: يعني الشجرة التي منها الزناد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fire is a reminder and sign of resurrection, or a reminder in darkness and model of Hellfire.
rows.anchor: تبصرة في أمر البعث كما مر في سورة «يس»

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire benefits travelers in barren country, or those whose stomachs or provisions are empty; the latter sense derives from a deserted house.
rows.anchor: للمقوين } الذين ينزلون القواء وهي القفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: يوم is accusative through مهين or an implied اذكر.
rows.anchor: منصوب ب { مهين } أو بإضمار اذكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All means none is left unresurrected, or that they are gathered together.
rows.anchor: كلهم لا يدع أحدا غير مبعوث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God informs them publicly before all witnesses, exposing their state and establishing punishment.
rows.anchor: على رؤوس الأشهاد تشهيرا لحالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God counted everything without omission; they forgot through its abundance or their collusion in it.
rows.anchor: أحاط به عددا لم يغب منه شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nothing is absent from God's witnessing.
rows.anchor: والله على كل شيء شهيد } لا يغيب عنه شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows all things, universal and particular.
rows.anchor: أن الله يعلم ما في السموات وما في الأرض } كليا وجزئيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase can mean a private conversation of three; one may supply a noun or construe نجوى as “conversers” and make ثلاثة its adjective.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يقدر مضاف أو يؤول { نجوى } بمتناجين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: نجوى derives from raised ground: a secret is raised into the mind and inaccessible to everyone.
rows.anchor: واشتقاقها من النجوة وهي ما ارتفع من الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is “fourth” by knowing the conversation; the exception ranges over states generally.
rows.anchor: إلا الله يجعلهم أربعة من حيث أنه يشاركهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The numbers may reflect the occasion of hypocrites' talks, or the odd numbers since God is One and loves odd numbers.
rows.anchor: فإن الآية نزلت في تناجي المنافقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, consultation requires two opposed parties and a third to mediate.
rows.anchor: لا بد له من اثنين يكونان كالمتنازعين وثالث يتوسط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading puts ثلاثة and خمسة in the accusative as circumstantial, supplying يتناجون or construing نجوى as “conversers.”
rows.anchor: وقرىء { ثلثة } و { خمسة } بالنصب على الحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The range includes fewer than three, such as one or two, and more than five, such as six and above.
rows.anchor: ولا أقل مما ذكر كالواحد والاثنين

rows.speaker: يعقوب
rows.claim: Yaqub reads ولا أكثر in the nominative, coordinated with the position of من نجوى or لا أدنى.
rows.anchor: وقرأ يعقوب ولا أكثر بالرفع عطفا على محل من

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's knowledge is not based on spatial nearness and so does not vary with locations.
rows.anchor: فإن علمه بالأشياء ليس لقرب مكاني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On Resurrection God exposes them publicly and establishes the recompense they deserve.
rows.anchor: تفضيحا لهم وتقريرا لما يستحقونه من الجزاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows all because His essence, which entails knowledge, relates equally to everything.
rows.anchor: لأن نسبة ذاته المقتضية للعلم إلى الكل على السواء
